schema.description: One destination scan (ADR 0031): what line the operator claims the goods belong to, which site received them, and how many were counted.

transferId.description: The planning context's transfer (saga) id; must match the ledger row for transferLineId.

destinationSiteId.description: The receiving site; may not equal the transfer's own origin site.

receivedQuantity.description: Quantity physically counted at the dock. May differ from expectedQuantity — the signed variance is recorded, never absorbed.
